runtimeFindings: Nine HSK2 matching exercises previously required serialization of hidden word/pattern mappings; now render selects and grade all pairs independent of answer-array order.
Stimulus cloze/source/incorrect/dialogue-context fields were missing from the exercise view.
HSK3 after-answer transcripts were rendered before answering.
Vocabulary/matching exercise errors were not connected to word-level SRS; now record first submission per attempt only.
Zero eligible questions previously appeared as learner failure; now explicitly Chưa đủ dữ liệu đánh giá and still allow next lesson.
approved is a valid schema status but was excluded by HSK2–3 eligibility; recognized without changing content metadata.
Text rubric labels previously received a percent suffix.
Public selectLevel/Học tiếp could render before gated mount bound click listeners, leaving Check buttons inert after reload/retry; entry now binds events idempotently.
Retry was restoring the previous last exercise instead of starting at the first; explicit retry now resets only the exercise position, preserving completion.
Saved answer-status badges did not refresh after a corrected answer; they now show the current result.
At mobile 390px the fixed previous/next toolbar covered matching inputs; for HSK2–3 mobile only, it now stays in lesson flow above the existing bottom padding.

teacherReviewQueue.instruction: Review answer correctness, legitimate variants, alignment and pedagogy independently before changing reviewStatus; these fixes do not constitute linguistic signoff.
